name: Sigmax exponential-mu profiles (Krea 2, Qwen Image dynamic, Qwen 2.1)
plain: Same linspace grid, but bent with the Flux-style exponential shift. μ is either fixed (Krea 2 Turbo 1.15, 8 steps) or set from the image token count on a straight line: Krea 2 RAW and LoRA experimental use 256 tokens → 0.5 and 6400 → 1.15, with no clamping. Qwen Image dynamic uses 256 → 0.5 and 4096 → 1.15. Qwen 2.1 uses (w/16)·(h/16) tokens, 256 → 0.5 and 8192 → 0.9, then stretches the schedule so the last nonzero sigma lands on 0.02. Qwen 2.1's other lanes use μ 1.15 or 0.69 on a 10000-entry table grid. The model-aware node only recognises Krea 2 (by class name or unet_config) and refuses any other model, then builds the Krea 2 schedule. The Krea 2 path does the arithmetic in 80-digit decimals so the result matches bit for bit across operating systems.
math:
Symbols: n steps; L image tokens; μ shift; t_i grid.
t_i = (n−i)/n. σ_i = e^μ·t_i / (e^μ·t_i + (1 − t_i)) = logistic(μ − ln((1−t_i)/t_i)); σ_n = 0.
μ(L) = μ₀ + (L − L₀)·(μ₁ − μ₀)/(L₁ − L₀).
Qwen 2.1 dynamic stretch: σ' = 1 − (1 − σ)·0.98/(1 − σ_{n−1}).

props.params: steps, width, height (or image_seq_len), variant / lane, start_step, end_step
